title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1981-07-08
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 08/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300's > lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII's. Recording by Jon Bernstein.

ai_review.summary: Excellent sound quality paired with a strong show featuring standout China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, highlighting a superb China/Rider pairing and an inspiring Scarlet/Fire transition, plus abundant Phil Lesh bass bombs. The recording is praised as dramatically clearer than old audience tapes, indicating a high‑quality source.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers give high marks (4–5 stars); the show is praised for its musical moments and the recording is described as a huge improvement over previous tapes, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the sound is dramatically better than older audience recordings, implying clear and clean audio despite no explicit source type.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Positive remarks about smooth transitions and abundant Phil Lesh 'bombs' suggest an engaging, well‑flowing set.

band_member_comments.Phil: Lots of Phil bombs throughout the show.
